flow.step: Hypertension diagnosis with a later BP reading
No death within 90 days of index

rules.index_date: first BP date on or after the first hypertension-coded admission
rules.coverage: Dec 31 of (anchor_year + 2020 - upper year of anchor_year_group) >= index + 730 days
rules.followup_end: earliest of: end of coverage, day 1460, last hospital/ED contact + 365, death
rules.rules_not_applied: >=2 BP dates; >=2 encounters or antihypertensive orders (both use post-index information)
